actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

dimensions.assessment: Affects manufacturers, importers, sellers, and consumers of electric bicycles and off-road electric devices, alongside federal, state, and local safety entities.
dimensions.evidence: Manufacturers, importers, and sellers of low-speed electric bicycles and other off-road electric devices.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes mandatory classification, labeling, age recommendation requirements, and sales prohibitions for specific electric devices.
dimensions.evidence: promulgate, under section 553 of title 5, United States Code, a final consumer product safety standard for the uniform classification and labeling

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $2,500,000 annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2031 for grants to relevant entities.
dimensions.evidence: authorized to be appropriated to the Commission $2,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031 to award grants

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new federal consumer product safety standard, reporting requirements, grant program, and training modules.
dimensions.evidence: treat as a consumer product safety rule promulgated under section 9 of the Consumer Product Safety Act

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent safety standards with a grant program spanning five fiscal years (2027 through 2031) and ongoing periodic crash analyses.
dimensions.evidence: For each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031, the Commission shall award grants

missing_information: Total baseline administrative costs for the CPSC to promulgate the rule beyond the authorized grant amounts are not specified.
The exact number of devices or manufacturers that will be impacted is unquantified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the Consumer Product Safety Commission to issue safety standards and labeling rules for low-speed electric bicycles and off-road electric devices, backed by multi-year grant authorizations.
